title: Reservation exceptions - synthetic training
transcript:
When a customer asks whether a reservation is active, New reservations last three days. Reservations already made keep their original seven-day window.
When a customer collects a reservation, check the reservation name and phone number.
When a customer returns a damaged book, place it on the back-room cart before issuing a refund.
